	tooltip = DA_GE_card_Dense_Muscle_tt
	potential = { always = yes }
	trigger = { always = yes }
	effect = { }
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Dense_Muscle } }

custom_button = {
	name = DA_GE_act_Dense_Muscle
	tooltip = DA_GE_act_Dense_Muscle_tt
	potential = { always = yes }
	trigger = {
		DA_GE_path_unlocked = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Dense_Muscle }
			always = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_distributing.Dense_Muscle }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_GE_being_distributed_tt always = no }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Dense_Muscle }
			DA_GE_can_apply_Dense_Muscle = yes
		}
		else = {
			DA_GE_path_unlocked = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Dense_Muscle }
				set_country_flag = DA_GE_remove_target.Dense_Muscle
				country_event = { id = DA_Genetic_Engineering_events.10 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_distributing.Dense_Muscle }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Dense_Muscle }
				DA_GE_start_distribution_Dense_Muscle = yes
			}
		}
	}
	frame = { number = 5 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_applied.Dense_Muscle } }
	frame = { number = 4 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_distributing.Dense_Muscle } }
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { has_country_flag = DA_GE_sequenced.Dense_Muscle } }
	frame = { number = 1 trigger = { always = yes } }
}

	name = DA_GE_counter_Dense_Muscle
	potential = { always = yes }
